title: GEMglUniform1fARB
description: specify the value of a uniform variable for the current program object

messages.description: new value of the uniform variable

arguments.description: new value of the uniform variable

body: [GEMglUniform1fARB] calls glUniform1fARB() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glUniform in the OpenGL reference.
